alternatives.behavior: Each contract version closes its own fields, language profile and capabilities; old consumers keep their exact validator.
alternatives.risk: Profile migrations require explicit compatibility and rollback tests.

alternatives.behavior: Artifacts carry a profile identifier resolved against a pinned registry; registry can describe capabilities but cannot change a consumer's compiled ce.v1 enum.
alternatives.risk: Registry drift or unpinned lookup creates interpretation ambiguity; offline digest and allowlist are mandatory.
